payload.reason: The evidence provides a comprehensive overview of various types of offensive content explored in social media, including hate speech, cyberbullying, aggression, and toxic comments.

claims.text: The types of offensive content explored include hate speech, cyberbullying, aggression, and toxic comments.
The Offensive Language Identification Dataset (OLID) includes tweets annotated for various offensive content types.
Aggression identification, bullying detection, and hate speech are specific sub-tasks within the broader category of offensive language.
